Class Matrix

java.lang.Object
org.example.Battleship.Models.Matrix
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Matrix extends Object implements Serializable
Represents the 10x10 game board matrix for Battleship. Manages cell states, ship positions and shot logic.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Javier Giraldo, Sebastian Niño, Pablo Arias
